items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I was the, I think I was the oldest in the group... Bruce Voorhees was late for the... we couldn't find him.

ctx.x: Radio and TV both scared you?

Television especially scared. Yeah. I was the, I think I was the oldest in the group. So I tried to be very cool about it. And what is the Peter Principle? Is that the Peter Principle? Something's going to happen. It will or something. And I can remember that it was a couple of last minute calamities. Now that's live television. No videotape. Yeah. I mean it was filmed. But it was, it was going out live at the time. And I think it was, it was Bruce Voorhees was late for the, we couldn't find him. And while they…
But didn't he ever bother to tune up?
